Hero.headline: I train even when no one's watching.
Hero.subtitle: Currently working as a PMO, on the path to AI Product Engineering.

About.title: About me
About.p1: I'm Lorenzo. I currently work as a PMO, coordinating projects, people and deadlines where process meets technology. Before that, a UX/UI design thesis taught me to always start from real data and real people before designing anything.
About.p2: Lately I've been shifting more and more toward AI applied to digital products: I study and build tools that mix design, development and a bit of product thinking — this site included, built more as an ongoing training ground than a business card.
About.p3: Outside of work I stay busy between dumbbells and pull-up bars: I do calisthenics consistently, I recently discovered I really love boxing, and sooner or later I'll get back into swimming too. I also collect trading cards — using tournaments across Europe as an excuse, I manage to mix fun and travel, which isn't a bad excuse at all.
About.p4: I follow economic news and market trends out of genuine curiosity, mostly just to understand how the world moves. And there's always a side project or two in the works — I like building things to learn, and I'm always up for a new challenge.
